posts: 💡 Small business tip: claim and complete your Google Business Profile. Add your opening hours, phone number, photos and services so people searching nearby can find and contact you.
📱 Most people browse on their phones. If your website is hard to read or use on a small screen, visitors may leave. Check yours on your own phone today.
🌍 Small business tip: a .co.za domain tells South African customers you're local, and it's easy to remember. Keep your domain name short and simple to spell.
✉️ Looking professional matters. An email address like info@yourbusiness.co.za builds more trust than a free webmail address on your quotes and invoices.
📅 Make it easy to buy from you. Online booking lets customers book at any hour, even when you're closed or busy with another client.
⭐ Ask happy customers for a review. Reviews help new customers trust you, so a short, friendly request after a job is well done goes a long way.
🔍 SEO basics: use clear page titles, describe your services in plain words, and mention your town or area so local customers can find you.
🔒 Check for the padlock. An SSL certificate (the padlock next to your web address) keeps data private between your visitor and your site, and customers look for it.
📞 Put your phone number and a clear call-to-action at the top of your website. Don't make customers hunt for how to contact you.
🖼️ Use real photos of your work, team and products. Genuine images build more trust than generic ones, and they make your business feel real.
⚡ Slow websites lose visitors. Compress large images and keep pages simple so your site loads quickly, especially on mobile data.
💬 Reply quickly. Customers who message your business often contact several others too, so a fast, friendly reply can win the job.
💾 Back up your website regularly. If something breaks or is hacked, a recent backup means you can get back online quickly.
🧭 Keep your details consistent. Use the same business name, address and phone number on your website, Google Business Profile and social media.
